localBaseline.provider: open-sse/providers/registry/firecrawl.js has serviceKinds ['webFetch'] and fetchConfig (POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/scrape) only; no searchConfig or searchViaChat
localBaseline.dispatch: open-sse/handlers/search/callers.js and normalizers.js have no firecrawl builder/normalizer; /v1/search answers 'Provider firecrawl does not support web search'
localBaseline.firecrawl_custom: self-hosted webFetch only; not a search equivalent and out of scope

exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; no credential mutation, cache, refresh, replay or failover; existing firecrawl apikey connection mode preserved

endpoints.discovery: none (model-less search provider; the source registry declares no model list or discovery endpoint)

envelope.request: POST { query, limit, sources: ['web'|'news'], country? (lowercased ISO-2), lang?, tbs? (qdr:d|w|m|y), includeDomains?, excludeDomains? } with Content-Type application/json and Authorization: Bearer <key>
envelope.response: v2 { success, data: { web?: [...], news?: [...] }, creditsUsed? }; hits rebuilt into the local unified SearchResult shape with source field precedence; unsafe URLs dropped
envelope.result: { provider: 'firecrawl', query, results, answer: null, usage: { queries_used: 1, search_cost_usd: 0.002 * max(1, ceil(results/10)) }, metrics, errors }

integration.provider: existing open-sse/providers/registry/firecrawl.js: append 'webSearch' to serviceKinds and add firecrawlSearchMetadata.searchConfig as searchConfig; preserve fetchConfig, auth and display
integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: dispatch handleFirecrawlSearchNative({ body, provider, credentials, signal, timeoutMs: min(30000, remaining global) }) for provider 'firecrawl' before the generic buildSearchRequest path (which has no firecrawl builder)
integration.publicHandler: src/sse/handlers/search.js recordSuccess: accounting.nativeUnits.operations is the returned-result block count, priced at searchConfig.costPerQuery as an estimate; acceptedJob on failures should be recorded as unknown-cost accepted work and never retried
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx, open-sse/AGENT-INDEX.md and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
hosted origin only: source FIRECRAWL_BASE_URL / params.baseUrl / providerSpecificData.baseUrl overrides are not ported; provider_options must be absent or empty
search_type web|news only; time_range any|day|week|month|year; max_results integer 1..100 (default 5); country ISO-2; offset/content_options refused (source silently drops them)
query at most 2000 characters after NFKC/whitespace normalization; at most 50 domain_filter entries, valid hostnames only
30s default and maximum per-call deadline; 4MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed; redirects and foreign-origin responses are refused
no scrapeOptions/markdown content, images source, streaming, polling, browser or WebSocket protocol
cost stays unknown in accounting; search_cost_usd is the source list-price estimate, creditsUsed is retained as native credits only
